urls.rationale: Article 1 (Short Title; Legislative Findings; Construction) houses the Ethics Act's short title, findings/purposes, construction rules, and severability — definitional support cross-referenced by Article 3.
Article 2 establishes the WV Ethics Commission (the body that administers lobbyist registration under Article 3) and defines its powers and duties — support for the lobbying-disclosure regime.
Article 3 (Lobbyists) is the core lobbying-disclosure statute body — registration, reports, gift restrictions, and penalties.

notes: Articles 2A (Rules) and 2B (Limitations on Use of Name/Likeness) are present in 2025 but outside the 2015 ground-truth scope of 24 sections across Articles 1-3; excluded as not part of the lobbying-disclosure regime.
